snippet: THE BLOCK: Greece's parliament has approved a 10% tax on cryptocurrency capital gains, exempting annual gains of up to €500 ($560). The legislation also introduces a 15% tax on income from staking, crypto lending, and DeFi liquidity provision, with the new rules set to take effect in January 2027.
